items.quote: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: Moses took the breast of the ram of consecration and waved it as a wave offering before the LORD. The breast was Moses' share, and he did this as the LORD commanded.
items.action: took and waved as a wave offering
items.object: breast of the ram of consecration (Moses' part)
items.mechanism: ritual wave offering performed by divine command
